items.raw_excerpt: This French word has nothing to do with small onions or herbs.
items.summary_en: Ciboulot is an informal French word for head. It is not related to onions or herbs despite sounding similar to other French food words.
items.summary_ko: 시부로는 머리를 뜻하는 프랑스어 비속어입니다. 양파나 허브를 뜻하는 프랑스어 음식 단어와 비슷하게 들리지만 실제로는 관련이 없습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: It's not long now until Italy’s schoolchildren file back into class for the new academic year. Here are the important dates you need to know for your region, from start dates to Christmas and Easter holidays.
items.summary_en: Italian schools will reopen soon for the 2026-2027 academic year. Start dates, Christmas holidays, and Easter breaks vary by region. Here is what parents need to know.

items.raw_excerpt: Line Barfod, the Copenhagen mayor for climate, environment and technology, has called for a 30km/h speed limit to be introduced in the vast majority of the city in a bid to make it safer and more bicycle-friendly.
items.summary_en: Copenhagen's climate and environment mayor is pushing for a 30 km/h speed limit in most of the city. She says it will make streets safer and more friendly for bicycles. The plan is part of her push for a greener, more livable capital.
items.summary_ko: 코펜하겐 기후환경 담당 시장이 시내 대부분 지역에 시속 30km 속도제한을 도입해야 한다고 요구하고 있다. 더 안전하고 자전거 친화적인 도시를 만들기 위한 취지다. 이번 제안은 수도를 더욱 살기 좋은 곳으로 만들려는 노력의 일환이다
items.title_en: Copenhagen mayor wants 30 km/h speed limit across city
items.title_ko: 코펜하겐 시장, 시내 대부분 30km/h 속도제한 추진
items.title_original: Copenhagen climate mayor calls for 30 km/h speed limit across city

items.raw_excerpt: The leaves are changing, and the days are getting short, which brings us to today’s word of the day.
items.summary_en: As leaves change and days grow shorter, the Norwegian word of the day is Høst. Høst means autumn or fall in Norwegian. The Local Norway highlights one Norwegian word each day to help readers learn the language.
items.summary_ko: 단풍이 물들고 낮이 짧아지는 요즘, 오늘의 노르웨이어 단어는 Høst입니다. Høst는 노르웨이어로 가을이라는 뜻입니다. The Local Norway는 매일 하나의 노르웨이어 단어를 소개하며 언어 학습을 돕고 있습니다.
